verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a public Python client (edison-client) authenticated with API tokens. It supports task submission via `create_task` and `run_tasks_until_done`, async batch submission with later retrieval, file and data-storage upload, artifact retrieval, and persistent chat sessions, so the product can be driven programmatically end to end. missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/raw REST reference (probes for openapi.json returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of the API.
